what_you_must_do: Use AG Studio: custom widgets, theming, layout tools, and ideally the Studio Agent Framework. Boilerplate: paypaldev/hackathon-paypal-ag-grid-boilerplate. 45-day trial.
effort: Medium - 1-2 days for a genuinely polished dashboard
risk: Trial expiry (45 days from signup) could break the judge's run before 15 Dec. Ship a licence-free fallback.
verdict: BEST CASH EV. 5 slots, $10k, and every money product needs a data surface.

what_you_must_do: Use the Context Plugin (free, PayPal already enabled) while building; winners used it. Everyone who uses it gets 1 month Basic.
risk: Judges reward 'best use'; a dev-time-only plugin may look thin unless you also generate an SDK or portal.
verdict: CHEAPEST SECOND POOL. Nearly free to qualify; ~6-10% odds of $1k.

what_you_must_do: Gantt / Scheduler / Calendar must be central. Trial npm packages: @bryntum/scheduler-trial.
effort: High - needs a genuine time dimension in the product
risk: Trial builds watermark and can expire; on a judge's machine that is worse than no prize.
verdict: BEST RATIO IF IT FITS. Only ~23 entrants mention it, but only worth it if your product really has a timeline.

what_you_must_do: Must actually call the API (or MCP) for search/enrichment/recommendation. Referencing it without calling fails. Promo PAYPAL-HACKATHON-2026 for 20,000 credits.
risk: Single winner, so odds are worse than AG Grid's five slots despite similar effort.
verdict: GOOD SUPPORTING TOOL. Natural for any commerce concept; weak as a standalone prize target.

what_you_must_do: Deploy on Render and use Render Workflows to orchestrate agents. $50 credits via the hackathon portal.
effort: Low - it is hosting you need anyway
risk: Zero cash. Value is the hosted demo URL, which satisfies a hard requirement.
verdict: USE IT REGARDLESS of the prize: a live URL until 15 Dec is a submission requirement.

what_you_must_do: Zapier MCP lets agents act across 9,000+ apps. 14-day Pro trial on new accounts.
risk: No prize exists. Do not spend time here for prize reasons.
verdict: SKIP unless it genuinely accelerates something.

what_you_must_do: Elasticsearch + Jina embeddings for retrieval; 14-day trial, extendable 30 days.
verdict: SKIP. Note: 0% of entrants use it, but there is nothing to win.

what_you_must_do: $50 credits for cloud browsers (sub-30ms spin-up, headful Chromium, session replay).
verdict: OPTIONAL TOOL if you need browser automation in the demo.

what_you_must_do: API design/testing; PayPal collection available on Postman.
verdict: Use for your own testing if you like. Not a prize path.

what_you_must_do: Agent operating system: declarative spec, CLI build/push, deploy via API or dashboard.
verdict: SKIP for prizes. Interesting runtime if you want managed agent hosting.
